ticket.summary: App crashes when opening Profile while offline
ticket.description:
Steps to reproduce:
1) Sign in normally with network connection
2) Enable airplane mode on the device
3) From Home, tap the Profile bottom-nav tab

Expected: Profile screen shows cached user info and a banner 'You are offline'.
Actual: App crashes immediately with an NPE in ProfileViewModel.load(). Crashlytics shows ~1200 instances in the last 7 days.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user is signed in and offline, when they tap Profile, then the Profile screen renders cached info with an 'Offline' banner.
Given the user is offline with no cached profile, when they tap Profile, then a friendly empty state 'Couldn't load profile — try again when online' is shown.
No NullPointerException is reported in Crashlytics for ProfileViewModel.load() after the fix.

expected_scenarios: regression: offline + no cache → empty state
edge: airplane mode toggled during navigation
